name: @glass/wasm
description: Glass Wasm: a WebAssembly VM written from scratch in Rust, with a debugger you can see through, graded by the official spec testsuite.
author: Vin, Vin's Atelier (https://vwesley.dev)

scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p glass-wasm && node scripts/copy-wasm.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test:rust && npm test && npm run build
